dependency_audit.meaning: Counts represent vulnerable dependency entries including inherited issues, not distinct exploitable issues in the published static site

findings.detail: Known vulnerable Astro/Vite/esbuild/Sharp dependency chain. Critical Astro AVIF advisory requires attacker-controlled AVIF processing; no such public processing endpoint or import observed. PNG hero served as static public file. Vite Windows file disclosure requires network-exposed development server and sensitive file in allowed directories; exposure not verified.
findings.remediation: Upgrade to supported patched Astro and transitive packages in a separate validated change, then audit/check/build. Do not apply npm audit fix --force without migration review.

findings.detail: pages:write and id-token:write set at workflow scope, inherited by build. Deploy job has no event/ref condition excluding pull_request. GitHub repository/environment policy may block PR deployment, so actual bypass is not established.
findings.remediation: Keep workflow/build contents:read; grant Pages and OIDC permissions only to deploy. Deploy only trusted master branch pushes or manual dispatch on master. Verify branch and environment protection.

findings.detail: gtag downloaded before choice. Consent flags passed to config rather than a consent default command before measurement; no valid default consent instruction exists. Saved accepted/rejected choices are not replayed on load. gtag wrapper pushes an Array instead of documented arguments shape; integration should be corrected together. Actual cookies/network measurement not browser-verified. Policy says analytics cookies stay disabled until consent, which current implementation does not ensure.
findings.remediation: Initialize valid default denied state before config/event; restore saved consent; use documented gtag wrapper; preferably load analytics only after explicit consent for data minimization. Grant only analytics consent unless advertising is intended. Provide revocation on all pages and review GA retention/access.

findings.detail: app.url inserted unescaped and without protocol allowlist into innerHTML; escapeHtml protects text but does not escape attribute quotes used in QR alt. JSON embedded through set:html is not protected from literal closing script sequences in future URL keys. Current 11 URL records are HTTPS and lack quotes or angle brackets; no public input or current malicious record observed.
findings.remediation: Create DOM with textContent and attribute setters; validate URLs as HTTPS; escape less-than signs in script-embedded JSON; validate directory schema at build.

findings.detail: Actions referenced using mutable version tags; no Dependabot config or dependency audit job found in working tree. Hosted alert settings not verified.
findings.remediation: Pin Actions to verified full commit SHA and configure update automation and CI audit.

ipa_followup: Inventory responsible owners and access for GitHub/Actions/Pages/npm/GA4
Review login, membership, token/App and deployment changes over past 1 month then expand to 3 months, preserving available logs
Check unknown or reactivated accounts and unusual login IPs/times
Verify MFA, least privilege, branch/environment protection and log retention
Document minimal data inventory and GA4 retention, and who reviews logs
If suspicious logs/accounts are found, preserve evidence and initiate incident response; this review does not establish presence or absence of compromise
